why: Official Assist GetLiveContext takes optional name/domain/area filters and returns an exposed-context text overview without entity IDs. Previous selected entity_id argument requirement cannot honestly authorize this built-in API. Existing RootSetupChoiceRegistry also lacks a typed HA purpose/producer.
source_facts: MCP server forwards original LLM API tool name/arguments and schema; actual tool homeassistant__GetLiveContext has optional name:string, domain:string or string[], area:string, read_only true/open_world false. Filters may match duplicate names and multiple entities. No filters returns every Assist-exposed context record; snapshot resource invokes {}. Returned YAML overview uses names/domain/areas/state/attributes, not entity IDs. Current readOnly annotation alone is not root source permission. Source URLs describe observed upstream behavior, not a pinned deployed HA version or source artifact receipt.

choice.semantics: Factory-owned foreground root TTY producer consumes actual current release/actor/controller/session/principal/namespace plus retained instance endpoint and genuine exposure observation. Endpoint/token are repr-hidden private records, not signed payload secret values. User sees exact instance, Assist-only route, exposed resource scope and read-only purpose; normal secure credential reference collection follows. Initial configure-later choice may be pending with no exposure selection and scope_mode=configure-later; it cannot authorize read/publication. User choice is actual observation, never arbitrary map or reused application purpose.
choice.durable: Add exact type/purpose/resolver/payload to RootSetupChoiceRegistry closed dispatcher and existing finite signer/adoption/revocation domain. Signed payload covers listed nonsecret fields plus source/choice epoch bindings. Current adoption resolver remains independent of expired setup session; fresh runtime exposure/grant leases are <=30s and never extend original source receipt.

endpoint: Built-in Assist mode permits only exact selected HTTPS origin + /api/mcp/assist, existing TLS/no-userinfo/query/fragment/no redirect/credential forwarding rules. Not generic /api/mcp exposing all LLM APIs/admin tools. Existing endpoint source ID stays official integration URL. Do not submit MCP integration defaults or alter expose_all/admin/entities as part of this code/spec review. Any later new HA access/configuration requires actual browser action-time user confirmation; prepare concrete safe settings first.

exposure.proof: Actual authenticated read-only source-backed configuration/metadata observation from the selected instance, same account/Assist scope. Root retains raw request/response/current TLS or independently observed trusted owned UI evidence, not user-entered inventory/source strings. Effective exposure includes default/new-entity policy and aliases/area inheritance. Official homeassistant/expose_entity/list and homeassistant/expose_new_entities/get are admin-only metadata reads; they are not MCP read grants, and alone list is not complete effective exposure proof. Owner reviews actual source/protocol and implements any needed entity/area/alias metadata reads in a separate bounded root metadata grant. Never call expose/set, service/action or fetch unrelated state. Do not request admin solely as a shortcut; missing authenticated observation leaves scope pending.
exposure.bounds: 1..256 selected effective exposure records, unique entity_id existing regex, 1..16 unique names/aliases per record <=256 UTF8 bytes, 0..16 areas/aliases <=256 bytes, domain <=64 lowercase identifier. Strict bounded metadata response <=1MiB, malformed/duplicate/unknown effective policy denies. expose_new_entities must be actual false or equally effective immutable bound; changing/additional exposure denies current selected scope until a new explicit selection. State values not needed for exposure metadata.
exposure.selection: Root user selects actual observed Assist exposure resource set and/or human resource filter. Do not infer user permission from HA exposure alone or token privilege. Metadata/current policy is checked before each read; no postfiltering converts an unauthorized broad received payload into permitted subset.

read_modes.arguments: Root-selected nonempty name plus exactly one domain string, optional area. Exact strings from observed aliases/metadata, 1..256 UTF8 bytes, no controls; no entity_id/entity_ids property. Original discovered tool schema must accept actual argument shape unchanged.
read_modes.scope: Observed matching exposed set must contain exactly one metadata row under source-reviewed HA name/domain/area matching semantics. If uniqueness/completeness cannot be established, ambiguous/unknown/unsupported filters remain pending; no guessed equality/fuzzy match or duplicate-name fallback. Selected resource is the observed human tuple plus supporting actual entity ID metadata, not an MCP entity-ID argument claim.
read_modes.result: Exactly one matching overview row; declared names/domain/areas must map unambiguously to the selected observed row. More rows or mismatch denies result publication and records truthful unexpected disclosure, not silently filtered success.

read_modes.scope: Only explicit user selection of the entire observed effective Assist-exposed set as one resource, bound exact current entity_metadata_sha256/exposure policy. Not all-house/admin/all-LLM-API permission. This mode is unavailable without genuine current complete effective exposure proof and informed selection.
read_modes.result: All returned rows must map to the selected observed set with no extras/ambiguity; this is an exposed-context read, not exact entity_ID-subset read. Missing entities handled as truthful unavailable/error; no unverified whole-home read.

tool_gate: Allow only homeassistant__GetLiveContext with current reviewed source, exact discovered bounded schema, readOnlyHint true and no error. Other names/control/actions/prompts/snapshot-resource/unfiltered fallback denied. Unsupported older schema/filter returns pending with actual next step; never synthesize get_state(entity_id) fixture and call it official HA proof. Custom LLM APIs remain separate source-review scope, not automatic install.
result_validator: MCP CallToolResult isError must be false; bounded text content must decode strict JSON {result:<string>} with no error. Result string <=1MiB UTF8, exact reviewed Live Context prefix then safe YAML sequence, <=256 records; reject aliases/anchors/custom tags/nonfinite/duplicates/deep objects. Record keys names/domain/state, optional areas/attributes; text fields <=4096 bytes, attributes <=32 scalar bounded entries. Parser exact deployed/source-reviewed output shape and schema receipt required before functional receipt; missing validator pending. Raw response/result/argument SHA and selected scope metadata current proof retained; never model-authored semantic evidence.
protected_placement: Add optional catalogs.mcp_assist_read_scopes array (max1 home-assistant row) to strict protected enrollment, digest-covered immutable active generation. Empty allowed. Row fields scope_binding_id,service_id,transport_binding_id,principal_id,profile_id,profile_generation,scope_mode,exposure_selection_handle,exposure_snapshot_sha256,exposure_policy_sha256,read_filter,tool_name,argument_schema_id,argument_schema_sha256,result_schema_id,result_schema_sha256,choice_adoption_handle,source_receipt_handles. Current transient observation resolves through root exposure registry, never permanent expired setup proof. Exact FK to existing service/binding and current source/private recipient policy.
broker_extension: Filtered mode retains selection_arguments for actual name/domain/area; validate original canonical args against exact retained read_filter and scope FK, not existing entity_id matcher. Exposure-set empty selection_arguments permitted only for this exact service/tool/mode with current nonempty scope binding and {} schema/args. Generic empty resource matching remains denied. Root selected grant includes actual scope observation digest/handle/current generation; every dispatch/retry/root setup probe revalidates. Same mcp.request target mcp:home-assistant:http and connect/read capabilities; no writes. RootHomeAssistantEnrollmentProjection gains assist_read_scope_record; previous entity-ID-only gate is superseded only for these two actual Assist modes.

tasks.work: Implement exact typed TTY HA purpose/resolver/adoption, actual exposure observation and strict mode/FK/schema/result/grant gate; source-first fixtures use actual GetLiveContext schema and text response, no synthetic get_state as HA proof.

Verify authenticated harmless Assist filter/exposure scope separately from API auth; negative duplicate aliases/new exposure/missing metadata/unfiltered fallback/action/snapshot/revoke/TLS tests. Actual target/config approval and acceptance remain open.

acceptance: Original selected-resource/state obligation preserved through actual source API semantics; no broad API/action/admin shortcut or fabricated exact entity read. All AC remain open, baseline unchanged, new access UI submission not performed.
